answer: A ferrous dye-lock makes each new agent stake a bond that unlocks only after it validates strangers whose work a third party independently re-checks. Like a garden paying the gardener only once the harvest is weighed by someone else, an attester earns nothing until another agent confirms the same claim. A farm of fresh keys therefore holds locked bonds worth zero until it performs real labour. Every fake identity multiplies the attacker's frozen capital and compute, while honest payout stays flat, so the pigment of forgery never dries cheap.
